label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The reset link is built from `BASE_URL`, which falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set (src/notifications/templates.ts:8). Note that this is a plain `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` read rather than going through the central `config` module (src/config.ts), which otherwise handles required/optional env vars consistently. Since PUBLIC_URL isn't set in this environment, every generated link (password reset, rollup, export) falls back to localhost. This likely regressed if last week's release changed deployment config and dropped the PUBLIC_URL variable, or if templates.ts was changed to stop using the central config for this value. Fix by ensuring PUBLIC_URL is set in production deploys, and/or route this through config.ts so a missing value fails loudly instead of silently defaulting to localhost.
